name: MPVONC
definition: A heuristic extension of MPVO to nonconvex meshes that sorts exterior cells with exterior front-facing faces by decreasing distance of centroid to viewpoint, then conducts DFS from each sorted cell.
summary: MPVONC is a fast, approximate heuristic for sorting non-convex cells in volume rendering, extending MPVO with centroid-based sorting and depth-first search to handle non-convex meshes.
